items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Well, Roy scratched his head and went on back in his office, as if to say, 'Poor girl, I'll let her stay.'

ctx.x: See? So when I went down there I sang those two songs in high soprano, and you know as heavy as my voice is, but what did I know. And I still don't know one note from the other. So I sang all Night Long, and 'Where the River Shannon Flows.' Well, Roy scratched his head and went on back in his office, as if to say, 'Poor girl, I'll let her stay.' So they let me stay. And each day I would learn a song on that player piano.
